4: let actx = null;
5: let master = null;

8: function ensure() {
9:   if (actx) return actx;
10:   try {
11:     actx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
12:     master = actx.createGain();
13:     master.gain.value = C.AUDIO.master;
14:     master.connect(actx.destination);
15:   } catch (e) { actx = null; }
16:   return actx;
17: }
18: 
19: function noiseBuffer(sec) {
20:   const buf = actx.createBuffer(1, Math.floor(actx.sampleRate * sec), actx.sampleRate);
21:   const data = buf.getChannelData(0);
22:   for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
23:   return buf;
24: }
25: 
26: function playOsc(type, f0, f1, dur, vol = 0.3, delay = 0) {
27:   if (!actx || muted) return;
28:   const t0 = actx.currentTime + delay;
29:   const o = actx.createOscillator();
30:   const g = actx.createGain();
31:   o.type = type;
32:   o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, t0);
33:   o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(1, f1), t0 + dur);
34:   g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
35:   g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + dur);
36:   o.connect(g); g.connect(master);
37:   o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + dur + 0.02);
38: }

41:   if (!actx || muted) return;

44:   src.buffer = noiseBuffer(dur);
45:   const f = actx.createBiquadFilter();
46:   f.type = type;
47:   f.frequency.value = filterFreq;
48:   const g = actx.createGain();
49:   g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, t0);
50:   g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, t0 + dur);
51:   src.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(master);

1: /* weapons.js — viewmodels procedurais, recuo, muzzle flash, hitscan, rocket spawn.
2:  * 🎨 Render: usa THREE (malhas presas à câmera) + weapons-core.js (math pura).
3:  * Disparos de projétil delegam ao módulo de projectiles via hook.
4:  */
5: import * as THREE from 'three';
6: import { C } from './constants.js';
7: import { fireReady, canFire, consumeAmmo, spreadOffset, chaingunSpread } from './weapons-core.js';
8: import { raycastWall } from './map.js';
9: 
10: const KEYS = ['1', '2', '3', '4'];
11: const NAMES = ['pistol', 'shotgun', 'chaingun', 'rocket'];
12: 
13: export function createWeapons(engine, player, scene, hooks) {
14:   const ammo = { shell: C.WEAPONS.shotgun.ammoStart, bullet: C.WEAPONS.chaingun.ammoStart, rocket: C.WEAPONS.rocket.ammoStart };
15:   let current = 0;
16:   let sinceLast = 99;
17:   let kick = 0;
18:   let muzzleT = 0;
19:   let spin = 0;
20: 
21:   const viewGroup = new THREE.Group();
22:   engine.camera.add(viewGroup);
23:   scene.add(engine.camera);
24: 
25:   const materials = {
26:     dark: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x2a2d33 }),
27:     steel: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x6a7078 }),
28:     grip: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4a3524 }),
29:     brass: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xb08a3a }),
30:   };
31: 
32:   function box(w, h, d, mat, x, y, z) {
33:     const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), materials[mat]);
34:     m.position.set(x, y, z);
35:     return m;
36:   }
37: 
38:   function buildViewmodel(type) {
39:     const g = new THREE.Group();
40:     if (type === 'pistol') {
41:       g.add(box(0.09, 0.13, 0.3, 'dark', 0, 0, 0));
42:       g.add(box(0.05, 0.05, 0.12, 'steel', 0, 0.08, -0.2));
43:       g.add(box(0.1, 0.06, 0.08, 'grip', -0.02, -0.09, 0.08));
44:     } else if (type === 'shotgun') {
45:       g.add(box(0.16, 0.09, 0.55, 'steel', 0, 0, 0));
46:       g.add(box(0.08, 0.09, 0.45, 'dark', 0.09, 0, -0.1));
47:       g.add(box(0.09, 0.05, 0.05, 'brass', 0, 0.07, -0.26));
48:       g.add(box(0.1, 0.12, 0.14, 'grip', -0.01, -0.13, 0.22));
49:     } else if (type === 'chaingun') {
50:       g.add(box(0.12, 0.14, 0.5, 'dark', 0, 0, 0));
51:       g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.3, 6).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), materials.steel)).position.set(0, 0.05, -0.25);
52:       g.add(box(0.1, 0.07, 0.12, 'grip', 0, -0.12, 0.1));
53:     } else {
54:       g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.07, 0.07, 0.5, 8).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), materials.dark));
55:       g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, 0.14, 6).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), materials.steel)).position.set(0, 0, -0.3);
56:       g.add(box(0.02, 0.2, 0.12, 'steel', 0.09, 0, 0.1));
57:       g.add(box(0.02, 0.2, 0.12, 'steel', -0.09, 0, 0.1));
58:       g.add(box(0.1, 0.08, 0.1, 'grip', 0, -0.13, 0.18));
59:     }
60:     g.position.set(0.26, -0.24, -0.45);
61:     return g;
62:   }
63: 
64:   const viewmodels = NAMES.map((n) => {
65:     const g = buildViewmodel(n);
66:     g.visible = false;
67:     viewGroup.add(g);
68:     return g;
69:   });
70:   viewmodels[0].visible = true;
71: 
72:   const muzzle = new THREE.Mesh(
73:     new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.06, 6, 6),
74:     new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffcc55, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 }),
75:   );
76:   muzzle.visible = false;
77:   viewGroup.add(muzzle);
78: 
79:   const camDir = () => {
80:     const e = new THREE.Euler(camera.rotation.x, camera.rotation.y, 0, 'YXZ');
81:     const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(e);
82:     const v = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1).applyQuaternion(q);
83:     return v;
84:   };
85: 
86:   const camera = engine.camera;
87: 
88:   function hitscanDamage(w, count = 1) {
89:     const dir = camDir();
90:     const origin = { x: camera.position.x, y: camera.position.y, z: camera.position.z };
91:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
92:       const s = spreadOffset(chaingunSpread(w.spread, spin));
93:       const dx = dir.x + dir.x * s.a - dir.z * s.b;
94:       const dz = dir.z + dir.z * s.a + dir.x * s.b;
95:       const wallDist = raycastWall(hooks.map, origin.x, origin.z, dx, dz);
96:       for (const e of hooks.getEnemies()) {
97:         if (e.dead) continue;
98:         const ex = e.x - origin.x, ez = e.z - origin.z;
99:         const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (ex * dx + ez * dz)));
100:         const px = origin.x + t * dx - e.x, pz = origin.z + t * dz - e.z;
101:         if (Math.hypot(px, pz) < 0.5 && t < wallDist) {
102:           e.takeDamage(w.damage * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4));
103:           hooks.impact(e.x, e.y + 1, e.z);
104:         }
105:       }
106:     }
107:   }
108: 
109:   function fire() {
110:     const w = C.WEAPONS[NAMES[current]];
111:     if (!canFire(w, ammo)) { hooks.noAmmo(); return; }
112:     if (!fireReady(w, sinceLast)) return;
113:     sinceLast = 0;
114:     ammo = consumeAmmo(w, ammo);
115:     kick = Math.min(1, kick + (w.rate < 0.15 ? 0.12 : 0.5));
116:     muzzleT = 0.045;
117:     if (current === 0) spin = 0;
118:     else spin = Math.min(1, spin + 0.25);
119:     hooks.shoot();
120:     if (NAMES[current] === 'rocket') {
121:       const dir = camDir();
122:       hooks.spawnProjectile({ x: camera.position.x + dir.x * 0.8, y: camera.position.y - 0.1, z: camera.position.z + dir.z * 0.8 }, dir);
123:     } else {
124:       hitscanDamage(w, NAMES[current] === 'shotgun' ? w.pellets : 1);
125:     }
126:   }
127: 
128:   function select(i) {
129:     if (i === current) return;
130:     current = i;
131:     viewmodels.forEach((g, k) => { g.visible = k === i; });
132:     kick = 0.3;
133:   }
134: 
135:   function update(dt) {
136:     sinceLast += dt;
137:     if (muzzleT > 0) {
138:       muzzleT -= dt;
139:       muzzle.visible = true;
140:       muzzle.position.set(0.02, 0.02, -0.62);
141:     } else muzzle.visible = false;
142: 
143:     kick = Math.max(0, kick - dt * 3.2);
144:     for (const g of viewmodels) {
145:       if (!g.visible) continue;
146:       g.position.z = -0.45 + kick * 0.28;
147:       g.position.y = -0.24 + Math.sin(player.bob * Math.PI * 2) * 0.008;
148:       g.rotation.x = kick * 0.25;
149:       if (NAMES[current] === 'chaingun') {
150:         g.rotation.z = Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.05) * 0.02;
151:       }
152:     }
153:     for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
154:       if (engine.wasPressed(KEYS[i])) select(i);
155:     }
156:     if (engine.input.scroll !== 0) {
157:       select((current + (engine.input.scroll > 0 ? 1 : 3)) % 4);
158:     }
159:   }
160: 
161:   return {
162:     ammo,
163:     get current() { return current; },
164:     get name() { return NAMES[current]; },
165:     update,
166:     fire,
167:     select,
168:     getViewmodel: () => viewmodels[current],
169:   };
170: }
171: 
172: export default createWeapons;

-set -euo pipefail
-
-CARD="/sys/class/drm/card1/device"
-SRC="/home/johncoffee/mi50-oc/pp_table_v26b_2100_1200_live_safe.bin"
-BACKUP_DIR="/home/johncoffee/mi50-oc/backup"
-ETC_BIN="/etc/mi50-oc/pp_table_active.bin"
-UPP="/home/johncoffee/.local/bin/upp"
-V26B_MD5="c00b36ef46fc0d34f45fde0758499f03"
-
-RED='\033[0;31m'; GREEN='\033[0;32m'; YELLOW='\033[1;33m'; NC='\033[0m'
-DRY=0
-[ "${1:-}" = "--dry" ] && DRY=1
-
-echo "══════════════════════════════════════════════"
-echo "  MI50 setup v26b (LIVE) — 2100/1200/350W/-50mV"
-echo "  hotspot=150 (estável) · audit live-safe ativo"
-echo "══════════════════════════════════════════════"
-
-# ── 0. Pré-requisitos ───────────────────────────────
-[ "$(id -u)" -eq 0 ] || { echo -e "${RED}ERRO: rode com sudo${NC}"; exit 1; }
-[ -f "$SRC" ] || { echo -e "${RED}ERRO: $SRC não existe (rode no dir ~/mi50-oc)${NC}"; exit 1; }
-if [ ! -f "$CARD/pp_table" ]; then
-    echo -e "${RED}ERRO: PowerPlay desativado (amdgpu.dpm=0 no cmdline?) — cat /proc/cmdline${NC}"; exit 1
-fi
-grep -q "amdgpu.dpm=0" /proc/cmdline && { echo -e "${RED}ERRO: amdgpu.dpm=0 detectado${NC}"; exit 1; }
-[ -x "$UPP" ] || { echo -e "${RED}ERRO: upp não encontrado em $UPP${NC}"; exit 1; }
-
-if [ "${DRY:-0}" = "1" ]; then
-    echo -e "${YELLOW}═══ MODO DRY-RUN (nada aplicado) ═══${NC}"
-fi
-
-# ── 1. Backup do sysfs atual (só leitura — seguro mesmo em dry-run) ──
-mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"
-BK="$BACKUP_DIR/pp_table_antes_v26b.$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).bin"
-cat "$CARD/pp_table" > "$BK"
-echo -e "✅ Backup: $BK"
-
-if [ "${DRY:-0}" = "1" ]; then
-    echo -e "${YELLOW}[dry] ${CARD}/pp_table <- $SRC${NC}"
-    echo -e "${YELLOW}[dry] persistir ${ETC_BIN} <- $SRC${NC}"
-    echo -e "${YELLOW}[dry] SAIR sem aplicar (use sem --dry para aplicar)${NC}"
-    exit 0
-fi
-
-# ── 2. Aplicar v26b no sysfs (LIVE) ─────────────────
-echo -e "Aplicando pp_table v26b live... "
-cp "$SRC" "$CARD/pp_table"
-sleep 2   # dá tempo à engine re-aplicar tensão/clocks
-
-# ── 3. AUDIT 1: MD5 do sysfs == bin ─────────────────
-NEW_MD5=$(md5sum "$CARD/pp_table" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)
-if [ "$NEW_MD5" = "$V26B_MD5" ]; then
-    echo -e "  ${GREEN}[audit1] MD5 sysfs confere: ${NEW_MD5:0:16} ✅${NC}"
-else
-    echo -e "  ${RED}[audit1]❌ MD5 diverge: sysfs=$NEW_MD5 esperado=$V26B_MD5 → driver rejeitou${NC}"
-    echo "  Restaurando..."; cat "$BK" > "$CARD/pp_table"; exit 1
-fi
-
-# ── 4. AUDIT 2: diff upp(sysfs) vs upp(bin) = prova final ─────────
-cp "$CARD/pp_table" /tmp/upp/sysfs_tmp.bin 2>/dev/null
-"$UPP" -p /tmp/upp/sysfs_tmp.bin dump > /tmp/upp/sysfs.dump 2>/dev/null
-"$UPP" -p "$SRC" dump > /tmp/upp/bin.dump 2>/dev/null
-if diff /tmp/upp/sysfs.dump /tmp/upp/bin.dump >/tmp/upp/apply.diff 2>&1; then
-    echo -e "  ${GREEN}[audit2]✅ diff upp(sysfs) vs upp(bin) VAZIO → table 100% aceita${NC}"
-else
-    echo -e "  ${RED}[audit2]⚠️  diff existe (ver /tmp/upp/apply.diff) → driver aceite parcialmente${NC}"
-    head -20 /tmp/upp/apply.diff
-    echo "  Restaurando backup..."; cat "$BK" > "$CARD/pp_table"; exit 1
-fi
-
-# ── 5. AUDIT 3: anti-proteção (mclk preso em 350=SMU PROTECTION) ──
-sleep 1
-MCLK_TOP=$(cat "$CARD/pp_dpm_mclk" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+Mhz' | sort -t: -k1 -n | tail -1)
-echo -e "  mclk range tópico: ${MCLK_TOP}"
-if echo "$MCLK_TOP" | grep -qE '^35|^3[0-9]0Mhz'; then
-    echo -e "  ${RED}[audit3]❌ mclk preso em ~350MHz (SMU proteção) → rollback${NC}"
-    cat "$BK" > "$CARD/pp_table"; exit 1
-else
-    echo -e "  ${GREEN}[audit3]✅ mclk normal (não preso em 350) — SMU ok${NC}"
-fi
-
-# ── 6. Persistência ────────────────────────────────
-mkdir -p /etc/mi50-oc
-cp "$SRC" "$ETC_BIN"
-echo -e "${GREEN}✅ Persistido: ${ETC_BIN}${NC}"
-
-# ── 7. Estado pós-aplic. em tempo real ──────────────
-echo; echo "=== CLOCKS (nível com * = ativo) ==="
-for f in pp_dpm_sclk pp_dpm_mclk pp_dpm_fclk pp_dpm_socclk; do
-    echo "── $f ──"; cat "$CARD/$f" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/   /'
-done
-echo "Perf level: $(cat $CARD/power_dpm_force_performance_level 2>/dev/null)"
-
-echo
-echo "════════════════════════════════════════════════"
-echo -e "${GREEN}✅ v26b ATIVO (live). Para conferir under-load:${NC}"
-echo "   watch -n1 'sudo cat $CARD/pp_dpm_sclk | grep \"\\*\"'"
-echo "   rocm-smi --showclocks · --showtemp"
-echo "   Temp pós-box: edge/junction/mem deverão subir de forma normal."
-echo "   Se mclk preso em 350 ou freeze → restaure: sudo cat '$BK' > $CARD/pp_table"
\ No newline at end of file

-def patch_power(data: bytearray, power_w: int, tdc_a: int, mode: str) -> Tuple[bytearray, dict]:
-    """
-    mode:
-      - heuristic: troca ocorrências de 190W -> power_w em áreas compatíveis
-      - offsets: tenta escrever offsets fixos, mas só se o binário tiver tamanho mínimo
-    """
-    info = {"replacements": 0, "tdc_written": False, "mode": mode}
-
-    old_pwr = struct.pack("<H", 190)
-    new_pwr = struct.pack("<H", power_w)
-
-    if mode == "heuristic":
-        idx = 0
-        while True:
-            idx = data.find(old_pwr, idx)
-            if idx == -1:
-                break
-
-            # filtro simples para evitar sair trocando lixo aleatório:
-            # exige contexto mínimo e evita borda do arquivo.
-            start = max(0, idx - 8)
-            end = min(len(data), idx + 10)
-            ctx = data[start:end]
-
-            if len(ctx) >= 8:
-                zero_count = ctx.count(0)
-                # aceita somente se não parece padding puro
-                if zero_count < len(ctx) - 2:
-                    data[idx:idx + 2] = new_pwr
-                    info["replacements"] += 1
-
-            idx += 2
-
-    elif mode == "offsets":
-        # Mantém como fallback explícito. Não usa sem saber o layout do teu binário.
-        if len(data) < 0x4C:
-            raise ValueError("pp_table pequeno demais para patch por offsets.")
-        data[0x46:0x48] = new_pwr
-        info["replacements"] = 1
-
-    else:
-        raise ValueError("modo inválido")
-
-    # TDC em offset fixo somente como fallback opcional.
-    # Se o layout não bater, o ideal é gerar um parser específico do teu dump.
-    if len(data) >= 0x4C:
-        try:
-            data[0x4A:0x4C] = struct.pack("<H", tdc_a)
-            info["tdc_written"] = True
-        except Exception:
-            info["tdc_written"] = False
-
-    return data, info

-    else:

-    STATE_FILE.write_text(

-            indent=2,

-    )
-
-    if live:

-    log(
